animationRendering.method: Browser canvas pixel comparison using the same current marker shapes, with OpenLayers updateWhileAnimating disabled/enabled on the position and direction layers. During a 10 second north-up animation, change from an east compass beam to a north walking arrow, render and sample the new arrow position. This controls only the batching flags, not a complete historical build.
